title: Statistical Vignettes on the Grokking Phenomenon
abstract: arXiv:2610.18811v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work, we study grokking in a simple, analytically tractable setting whose rich phenomenology allows us to disentangle the effects of initialization, signal strength, weight decay, sample size, and input dimension. These factors can produce superficially similar learning curves through distinct mechanisms, complicating their interpretation. Our analysis distinguishes early fitting through nuisance features, core feature learning, and delayed generalization. We identify sharp conditions under which grokking provably occurs and derive analytic asymptotic expressions for the lengths of the generalization plateaus. Our results also characterize regimes of early generalization and failure to reach a prescribed test accuracy target. translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们在一个简单且可解析处理的设定中研究顿悟现象，其丰富的现象学使我们能够厘清初始化、信号强度、权重衰减、样本量和输入维度各自的 影响。这些因素可以通过不同的机制产生表面上相似的学习曲线，从而使对其的解读变得复杂。我们的分析区分了借助干扰特征的早期拟合、核心特征学习以及延迟泛化。我们识别出了顿悟可被严格证明发生的精确条件，并推导出泛化平台长度的解析渐近表达式。我们的结果还刻画了早期泛化以及无法达到规定测试精度目标的区域。我们证明插值边缘构成了一个独特的动力学区域，其中消失的谱隙将核心学习与泛化分离开来，这有助于澄清模型接近插值边界所扮演的角色。
tldr: 该论文在一个可解析求解的简单模型中研究“顿悟”现象，厘清了初始化、信号强度、权重衰减、样本量与输入维度等因素通过不同机制产生相似学习曲线的作用，给出了顿悟必然发生的严格条件、泛化平台长度的解析渐近表达式，并揭示插值边缘是由消失谱隙刻画的一个独特动力学区域。
en_tdlr: This paper studies grokking in a simple, analytically tractable setting, disentangling the effects of initialization, signal strength, weight decay, sample size, and input dimension, identifies sharp conditions under which grokking provably occurs with analytic expressions for generalization plateau lengths, and shows that the interpolation edge constitutes a distinct dynamical regime characterized by vanishing spectral gaps.
